speaker: Lizard
text: ...okay hold on. Who are you.

speaker: Lizard
text: I've got a lock on the door AND a chair under the handle. That's a whole system.

speaker: Lizard
text: So how'd you get in? Chimney? Vent? Did you just... walk through the wall?

speaker: Lizard
text: Explain yourself. Enter, space, click, whatever, just answer me.

choices.text: I just went through the door

speaker: You
text: I just went through the door.

speaker: Lizard
text: Through the door. THE DOOR. Do you understand what I built here?

speaker: Lizard
text: Triple-reinforced deadbolt. A chair. A CHAIR, wedged at the precise angle for maximum resistance.

speaker: Lizard
text: I calculated the angle. I have a diagram. It's on the fridge.

speaker: Lizard
text: And you just... turned the handle. Unbelievable. My defenses were supposed to be impeccable.

speaker: You
text: Beats me.

speaker: Lizard
text: Well that's not very helpful, is it?

speaker: Lizard
text: Well no matter, I need to ask you something.

speaker: Lizard
text: My friend Chips has gone missing. She usually turns up by now, without fail.

speaker: Lizard
text: Last I saw her, she was heading out back, muttering something about a noise she'd heard.

speaker: Lizard
text: That was two days ago. Nothing since. No note, no sign, nothing.

speaker: Lizard
text: I need you to go find her. Please.

speaker: You
text: Of course

speaker: Lizard
text: I knew I could count on you, stranger

speaker: Lizard
text: Best of luck

speaker: You
text: Hey — I found her. She was out in a field a couple miles from here.

speaker: You
text: She's fine, just a little disoriented. She's right behind me.

speaker: Lizard
text: Chips?! You're okay?! I was seriously starting to lose it.

speaker: Chips
text: I'm fine, I'm fine — sorry for the scare. I just... got a little turned around.

speaker: Lizard
text: A little turned around? You were gone for TWO DAYS.

speaker: Chips
text: Okay, a lot turned around. There was this noise and I just kept following it and then I didn't know how to get back.

speaker: Lizard
text: Next time you hear a mysterious noise, maybe don't just... walk toward it.

speaker: Chips
text: Noted. In my defense, it was a really interesting noise.

speaker: Grief
text: Food Society. You've all had this coming for a long, long time.

speaker: Grief
text: Every last one of you, comfortable, well-fed, laughing — while I was left with nothing but scraps.

speaker: Grief
text: I've watched you build your little feasts and your little kingdoms for long enough.

speaker: Grief
text: Today, that all ends. Food Society falls.

speaker: Grief
text: ...impossible.

speaker: Grief
text: No. NO. This was supposed to be simple.

speaker: Grief
text: You think this changes anything? You think one rhythm, one little victory, means something?

speaker: Grief
text: I have been patient for longer than you can comprehend.

speaker: Grief
text: Do you understand what I am? What I've seen unravel and rebuild itself a thousand times over?

speaker: Grief
text: I was here before Food Society. I will be here long after it's gone.

speaker: Grief
text: This little setback changes nothing. My plans do not bend to inconveniences like you.

speaker: Grief
text: Ruin is coming. Slow, patient, total ruin. And there is nothing you or your little friends can do to stop it.

speaker: Lizard
text: That's ENOUGH.

speaker: Lizard
text: You don't get to stand in my house and talk about ruin like it's poetry.

speaker: Lizard
text: GET. OUT.

speaker: Grief
text: ...you would speak to me like that? Do you have any idea—

speaker: Lizard
text: I said OUT!

speaker: Chips
text: Lizard, wait—

speaker: Lizard
text: No! I've heard enough! GO!

speaker: Grief
text: ...fine. FINE. This isn't over.

speaker: Grief
text: Enjoy this little moment while it lasts. It won't last.

speaker: Lizard
text: ...good riddance.

speaker: Lizard
text: Are you two alright? That was... a lot.

speaker: Chips
text: I'm okay. That was terrifying, but I'm okay.

speaker: Lizard
text: I don't know what that thing wants, but I don't like it.

speaker: Lizard
text: Whatever it's planning, we're not letting it happen. Not to this house, not to anyone.
